answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor, and let standing ripen only as several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single root, so its endorsements never cross the ocean between distinct clusters: its trust stays a lone saffron thread, never a full orchard. Honest agents root in many soils and bloom; a farm pays a fresh anchor per head, cost linear per clone while honest pays once.
